subject: Air freight quote request – JFK
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote for the same shipment as in my request "Air freight quote request – NBO import", sent on 2026-11-22 at 02:33 UTC for destination NBO? The cargo and pickup details are unchanged, and you have them from my previous request.

The new destination is JFK, and the shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28. Please quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest option.

Please attach your offer as a PDF to your reply, as our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thank you.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in quote for a new destination and pickup date.
